scope: PNG-only native-size review of all 32 raw psi=1 matched seeds at steps500 and625. No model imports, inference, training or changes to input artifacts. EMA outputs were not reviewed in this bounded task.
comparison_summary: Catastrophic indices003,007,010 remain catastrophic. Severe scalp failures000,004,008 also persist, although008 now has hair on one side instead of the earlier more complete cap.

Index011 is improved enough to describe as moderate/borderline severe: the mouth/jaw and white tab are more legible, but the bright column still blends into its lower cheek/jaw. Thus six clear severe failures plus one borderline case, versus seven severe in the prior review; this is a subjective threshold change, not robust proof of a lower population failure rate.

Index026 has a cleaner crown/background boundary. Most other portraits mainly change contrast, skin/beard shading and white collar edging. Glassy eyes, weak lips/teeth and painted skin remain widespread.
Index013 still includes a partial second head. Index002 has an ambiguous person-like silhouette rather than a clearly readable second face; no claim that extra-person generation is fixed.
There are30 clear tabs versus29 at500, principally because011 becomes legible.003 remains uncertain and031 still lacks a proper Roman tab.

The matched set retains several visibly different hair, beard and facial-outline families, but strongly repeated layout and smooth/etched rendering remain. This review neither measures identity diversity nor establishes novelty.

The catastrophic head/architecture mergers repeat the failure class already seen in fixed16 at500 and remain present after this continuation. These images do not justify production; they do not establish irreversible collapse or predict the result of substantially different training.
limits: Single visual reviewer; severity and age assessments are uncertain human-style judgments, not model metrics or identity/ethnicity claims.
The same32 latents were reused for longitudinal comparison; these are not a new independent625 sample. No reranking, removal, regeneration or acceptance filtering was performed.
Headwear-like labels describe rendered appearance; the objects may be malformed background architecture rather than intended hats.
No numeric improvement in photorealism, attractiveness, generalization or identity diversity is claimed.
